instruction: Stand the red pen upright in the magenta pen holder.

attempts.code:
# Grasp the red pen and insert it upright into the magenta holder
candidates = grasp_candidates("red_pen")
# Choose a candidate that grasps across the pen's short side near its center or end
cand = min(candidates, key=lambda c: abs(c["squeeze_width"] - 0.012))
grasp_res = grasp(cand)

if grasp_res["holding_something"]:
    obs = observe()
    holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
    hx, hy, hz = holder["center"]
    rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)

    # Carry above the holder, high enough to clear the rim
    carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.15)

    # To insert upright: orient gripper horizontally so pen points down
    # Currently pointing down with pen horizontal in the fingers (along side vector).
    # If we pitch gripper to horizontal (approach horizontal), the pen can point down.
    # Alternatively, lower_until_contact directly or insert vertically:
    # A pen grasped horizontally will not fit vertically unless reoriented.
    # We reorient the gripper so the pen aligns vertically (along -z).
    # Gripper side vector holds the pen long axis. To make side = [0, 0, -1], approach must be horizontal.
    gp = gripper_pose()
    # Align approach along +x or +y and side along [0, 0, -1]
    # Approach along [1, 0, 0], finger_axis along [0, 1, 0] gives side = [0, 0, -1]
    target_z = hz + rim_h + 0.06
    move_gripper(hx, hy, target_z, approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0], path="line")

    # Lower slightly into the holder
    move_by(dz=-0.04)
    open_gripper()
    retreat(0.12)
    go_home()
    check("red_pen", "magenta_holder")
